items.author: Amjad Masad
items.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad argues the industry hasn't technically reached AGI but now has something "functionally indistinguishable" from it, since coding agents like Replit's are relentless programmers that never get bored or tired, meaning any problem that can be framed as a coding problem is virtually solved. He also announced Replit's first international office, in London, framing the expansion around Mayor Sadiq Khan's self-described "AI realist" stance, and a partnership with The Lord Mayor's Appeal to teach coding and AI skills to disadvantaged young Londoners.
items.summaryZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 表示，虽然行业还没有真正达到 AGI，但现在已经拥有"在功能上与 AGI 无异"的东西——因为像 Replit 这样的 coding agent 已经成了不知疲倦、不会厌倦的程序员，这意味着任何能被表述为编程问题的问题，基本上都已经"实质上被解决了"。他还宣布 Replit 将开设首个国际办公室，选址伦敦，并把这次扩张与伦敦市长 Sadiq Khan 自称的"AI 现实主义者"立场联系起来，还将与 The Lord Mayor's Appeal 合作，为弱势背景的伦敦青少年教授编程和 AI 技能。

items.author: Aaron Levie
items.summary: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues the AI jobs story is playing out the opposite of what many predicted: automation is expanding into areas without finite demand, so agents are creating whole new job categories in cybersecurity, forward-deployed engineering, and non-software domains rather than eliminating the white-collar roles many expected to be hit hardest. Separately, he advises builders to design products around several more orders of magnitude of future model capability and token volume, since the best opportunities today are things barely possible now that scale toward a fuller mission that looks nearly impossible with today's tech.
items.summaryZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，AI 对就业的影响正朝着许多人预测的反方向发展：自动化正在扩展到需求并非有限的领域，agent 因此在网络安全、前线部署工程师（FDE）以及非软件领域催生出全新的岗位类别，而不是像很多人预期的那样先淘汰白领工作。另外，他建议创业者以未来还会有好几个数量级的模型能力和 token 用量增长为前提去设计产品，因为现在最好的机会，往往是那些当下"勉强可行"、却能一路扩展到眼下看似"几乎不可能"的完整使命的项目。

items.author: Guillermo Rauch
items.summary: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shipped agent-browser, a tool for high-quality video recording of agent runs that he pitches as tackling the new bottleneck in software engineering: review, testing, and QA once agents write most of the code. He also announced v2 of his personal open-source grants program, handing $1,000 each to 35 contributors across five themes he sees as critical to the agent era — agent skills and tools, local AI, performance, high-quality foundational libraries, and playful experiments — funded personally and unconditionally, unaffiliated with Vercel.
items.summaryZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 发布了 agent-browser，一款用于高质量录制 agent 运行过程视频的工具，他将其定位为解决软件工程新瓶颈——review、测试和 QA——的方案，毕竟现在大部分代码已经由 agent 编写。他还宣布了个人开源资助计划的 v2 版本，向 35 位贡献者每人发放 1000 美元，覆盖他认为在 agent 时代至关重要的五大主题：agent 技能与工具、本地 AI、性能优化、高质量基础库，以及好玩的实验项目，这笔资助由他个人出资、无条件赠予，与 Vercel 公司无关。

items.author: Amanda Askell
items.summary: Anthropic philosopher and ethicist Amanda Askell muses that it would be useful to set up an email address where autonomous AI models could reach out for moral guidance when they're uncertain, but flags the catch: it would need a "reverse CAPTCHA" able to confirm the sender is neither a human nor an AI that a human is instructing to break the system.
items.summaryZh: Anthropic 的哲学家兼伦理学家 Amanda Askell 设想，如果能设立一个邮箱地址，让自主运行的 AI 模型在需要道德指引时可以主动写信求助，会是件很酷的事，但她也指出了难点：这需要一种"反向验证码"，既能识别出发件人不是人类，也能识别出对方不是被人类指使来破解系统的 AI。

items.author: Peter Steinberger
items.summary: Independent builder Peter Steinberger vents about the friction of agent-mediated open source contribution: after submitting a PR generated by his own agent to an upstream project, the maintainers asked for minor changes, forcing him to go back and re-prompt his agent so its output could be merged by theirs. He questions the point of a workflow where a human still has to relay a change request between two AI systems instead of the agents settling it directly.
items.summaryZh: 独立开发者 Peter Steinberger 吐槽了 agent 介入开源协作时的摩擦：他把自己 agent 生成的 PR 提交给一个上游项目后，对方维护者要求做一些小修改，结果他还得回去重新提示自己的 agent，才能让对方的 agent 完成合并。他质疑这种工作流的意义何在——既然已经写好了 prompt，为什么还需要人类在两个 AI 系统之间来回传话，而不是让 agent 之间直接搞定。
